description: Definitions behind the six portfolio questions: the executive dashboard (Portfolio Health & Risk Intelligence) and the Insights screen. These are the factory values; every number below travels with each rules version and is edited from the portal (ADR 0024, ADR 0025).

currency.note: Currency Score = the score CMT delivers: Raw_Tech_Score from the Currency Model Detail Report, 0-100, computed per component from its end-of-life date (decided 2026-09-18). A 0 is no data, as in the score model. Legacy platform = Currency Score below the threshold; 60 is where the BRD's lowest band (0-59) ends.

risk.note: Risk Score 0-100, higher is worse: the Modernization Risk Vectors pillar inverted, (100 - pillar) / 80 x 100. Levels as in the mockup.

opportunity.note: Modernization opportunity = points the application's own roadmap adds to its score (what-if engine). Applications leaving the portfolio or without a plan stay out of the matrix.

criticality.note: Very high: critical and (significant user base or broad capabilities). High: critical. Medium: significant user base or broad capabilities. Low: the rest. The significant user base comes from the roadmap catalog.

candidates.note: Modernization candidates = the top-right quadrant of the matrix. Levels: 0 low, 1 medium, 2 high, 3 very high.

complexity.note: Duplicate technologies: the same primary capability in the same country at least this many times. Technology proliferation: one capability written in at least this many languages. Technical debt: the mapped Tech Debt Score at or below this score (20 is the BRD's worst band).

concentration.note: Risk Concentration Index = share of the total risk held by the riskiest fifth of the capability x axis cells. 0.2 is an even spread; 1.0 is all the risk in a few cells.

resilience.note: Recovery: outside the DR scope is high (critical if the application is critical); inside it, the lower bound of the RTO range decides. Operational vulnerabilities: the worst of the operational score and monitoring coverage. The application's level is the worst of its dimensions.

code.note: Code screen (ADR 0026): evidence from the repositories each application owns in GitHub Enterprise. A component is approaching its end of life when its cycle ends within approachingMonths, per the endoflife.date snapshot in contracts/eol-catalog-v1.json. A library is outdated when it is outdatedMajorsBehind or more major versions behind the latest release; a repository is stale after staleMonths without commits, or when it is archived. The code risk index adds the points below for every finding, and its levels follow moderateFrom < highFrom < criticalFrom. It does not change the Modernization Score.
